title: IUST observes World Diabetes Day with MoU signing, screening drive

ai.summary: The Islamic University of Science and Technology (IUST) in Awantipora observed World Diabetes Day 2026 with an MoU signing, screening drive, and expert lectures, emphasizing diabetes prevention and health awareness.

facts.claim: The Islamic University of Science and Technology (IUST) observed World Diabetes Day 2026
facts.quote: Awantipora, Nov 13: The Islamic University of Science and Technology (IUST) observed World Diabetes Day 2026 on Friday with a series of activities, including the signing of a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU), a felicitation ceremony, expert lectures and diabetes screening.

facts.claim: The programme was held at the Conference Hall of the Rumi Library, IUST
facts.quote: The programme was held at the Conference Hall of the Rumi Library, IUST.

facts.claim: Diabetes affects a substantial section of the global population
facts.quote: He said diabetes affects a substantial section of the global population and that, despite widespread awareness about preventive measures and lifestyle modifications, adherence remains a major challenge.

facts.claim: More than 101 million people in India were affected by diabetes
facts.quote: DrShujad Hussain Shuja, Assistant Director, AYUSH, said more than 101 million people in India were affected by diabetes, making preventive interventions particularly important.

facts.claim: Sustained lifestyle changes, including balanced nutrition, regular physical activity and effective stress management, were essential for preventing and managing diabetes
facts.quote: Sustained lifestyle changes, including balanced nutrition, regular physical activity and effective stress management, were essential for preventing and managing diabetes, he said.
